newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHKP says 90 pct of E.Point offer sold.
newsitem.headline: SHKP says 90 pct of E.Point offer sold.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday it had sold about 90 percent of the 1,864 flats on offer at its East Point City development in Hong Kong's Tseung Kwan O district over the weekend.
A company spokeswoman said the units went on sale on Saturday and Sunday and the sale continued late into Sunday night.
The spokeswoman said the company had added 256 units to the offer last Thursday, bringing the total number units on offer to 1,864.

Sun Hung Kai Properties opened the registration period for an initial 304 units last Monday and added two further batches of 152 units each later on Monday and Tuesday. A further 1,000 units were added at the close of the initial registration period on Wednesday before the addition of another 256 units.
The company had said a total 27,132 potential buyers had registered to buy the flats at the close of a three day registration last Wednesday.
Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties were down HK$1.00 at HK$90.25 at midday.
